name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.121.0 — `/spec:mocks` retires the THEME state: `deriveState` no longer derives THEME, the driver's authoring/gate/reopen surfaces drop direction-composed, theme-picked, stop open theme and --reopen theme, and status.json stops carrying theme/directions/marks.themePicked — the chain is now SEED -> SHAPES -> KIT -> WIREFRAMES -> SIGNOFF -> APPROVED, with the theme picked by /spec:sketch after sign-off instead. Both doctrine homes (spec/doctrine/mocks.md, spec/commands/mocks.md) stop describing the retired state, and render-gate.js's --mocks comment is repointed at the new theme-pick timing. 7.120.0 — Retained review and replay evidence artifacts are written as single-line .jsonl under .claude/spec-runs/ instead of pretty-printed .json. That path is tracked and inside the host's rule surface, so a host gateCommand that formats .claude/ reformatted the artifact — the first non-empty evidence array reddened a close gate over a file no session wrote, and a formatter run with --write would rewrite the very bytes /spec:escape's killedMatch derives from. .jsonl is the one shape no source formatter claims a parser for, and it inherits the run ledger's own host-compatibility surface; an ignore file was rejected as per-tool, since a gate that names paths consults none. Artifacts retained earlier keep the .json extension and stay readable — promotion walks the directory and /spec:escape reads by path, so nothing resolves an artifact by extension. The close-time gate refusal now tells the reader which path the gate output names before editing anything, since the pipeline's own artifacts under .claude/ sit in the host's rule surface but are driver-written, never files to hand-edit. 7.119.0 — The ```surfaces line grammar is parsed in exactly one place, `spec/scripts/lib/surfaces.js`, and `design-atlas.js` and `genesis-driver.js` both fold over it instead of carrying divergent copies; `genesis-driver.js` also drops its own synchronous stdout writer and fail-closed child runner for `lib/driver-io.js`, matching the review, build, and mocks drivers. Behavior is unchanged and both drivers shrink.
